metadata.description: An index of Claude Code plugins: delegation, focus and cache-status, each in its own repository

plugins.name: cache-status
plugins.description: Shows this session's prompt cache above the prompt: hit rate, countdown to cold, what a re-ingest would cost, and a Start fresh button that hands the work to a cleared conversation

plugins.name: focus
plugins.description: Keeps the one next action pinned above the prompt, with time on task, parked thoughts, today's wins and a where-you-left-off recap in a pane; bundles the i-have-adhd writing rules so every reply ends with that next action

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Everything for delegating coding work: Codex, agy and Claude worker skills; /delegate, /explore, /delegate-setup and /delegations; the official Codex plugin's commands bundled as /codex-* with matching /agy-* commands; a measured delegation policy that refuses tasks too small to be worth it; and a live view of running jobs and what they cost
